review.scopeLimit: Shared in-flight attachment custody is proven across store instances in one process; independent browser-tab/process coordination is not claimed.

notes: The common Chat composer remains backward-compatible with legacy plain-text draft records and scopes text, Reply/Edit context and staged attachments by actor generation and conversation.
A selected attachment is copied into app-owned durable cache before its draft reference is persisted; attachment-only drafts restore after recreation.

Send retains the exact staged attachment during the send operation. Repository acceptance cleans the composer copy without deleting a newer draft, while failure restores the durable attachment for retry.

Replace, clear, successful send, leave, delete and actor retirement schedule owned cleanup. Failed exact or generation-prefix cleanup stays durable and retryable, and acknowledgement cannot rewrite a stale draft snapshot.
Close waits for staging and the write created by staging. Shared in-process retention prevents a second store instance from deleting an attachment still used by an in-flight send.
Reply/Edit target restoration remains authoritative and fail-closed; user input, paging, actor retirement and stale-write invariants from the preceding unit remain covered.
The complete 39-test Web/Wasm focal class, Android and Web compilation, the complete iOS x64 focal class and the signed iOS host build passed on the Product SHA.
Independent review returned GO with no P0-P2 findings after four defect-fix rounds and confirmed that the earlier concurrency, attachment-only, cleanup and acknowledgement findings are resolved.
Scroll position and unrelated internal state remain transient. This unit does not claim authenticated backend, visual host E2E or coordination across independent browser processes/tabs.

Product SHA 143599e40 recomposes the unchanged attachment-restoration runtime onto the frozen context candidate. All seven changed feature source and test paths are byte-identical to the preceding composed Product SHA 8d37f114. The historical evidence report remains bound to report Git HEAD 612e37e8; documentation and attestation bindings were renewed, and no platform matrix was repeated solely for the base advance.
